meta.source: https://www.activepieces.com/sitemap.xml (6,518 URLs, captured 2026-10-16) mapped onto the local React clone's route table in src/App.jsx
meta.notes: routeCount = URLs listed in the original sitemap. The clone renders more than the sitemap in three places: /pieces/:a/:b accepts any two distinct valid piece slugs (not only the 3,000 listed), blog listing pagination (/blog/page/:n, /blog/category/:slug/:n, /blog/author/:slug/:n) is not in the sitemap, and src/data/blog.json holds 796 posts (794 shown in listings, 2 sitemap-only) / 95 authors vs 791 / 56 in the sitemap; the live blog publishes several posts per hour, so listing order at the top of /blog reflects the snapshot time. NotFound (*) is not counted.

categories.CHROME: Site-wide shell rendered by src/components/Layout.jsx around every routed page.
categories.OVERLAY: Modal/dialog layers opened from within a page rather than occupying a slot in the page flow.
categories.NAV: In-page wayfinding: breadcrumbs, pagination, category pills, tables of contents.
categories.HERO: The first block under the header that names the page and carries its primary CTAs.
categories.PRODUCT: Blocks that explain or demonstrate product capability (demos, bento grids, feature rows, scroll stories).
categories.PROOF: Social proof: customer logos, case studies, testimonials.
categories.CTA: Standalone conversion bands between content sections (not the footer's closing CTA).
categories.PRICING: Plan, price and comparison blocks specific to /pricing.
categories.CATALOG: Data-driven blocks fed by src/data/pieces.json and public/data/pieces/<slug>.json.
categories.CONTENT: Blog/resources listing and reading blocks fed by src/data/blog.json and src/data/resources.json (metadata only; bodies are placeholders by policy).

chrome.header.description: Fixed floating 'island' header: wordmark, Product/Solutions/Enterprise mega-dropdowns with a sliding highlight, Open app + Talk to sales CTAs, burger sheet below 1024px; hides on scroll-down past 160px. Transparent 'on-art' state only on the homepage.
chrome.header.scope: Every template except /sales, which renders outside Layout.

chrome.footer.description: Closing CTA over the meadow image (heading, lede, two buttons, optional reassurance list set per page via PageMetaContext/usePageClosing) followed by the multi-column links card with legal links and the YC badge.

chrome.floating-card.description: Fixed 'See it in action / Book a 30-min demo' card that fades in after scrollY > 100 and can be dismissed.
chrome.floating-card.scope: Every Layout template except /pricing and the blog templates (the live site also hides it on /sales, /admin and /customers).

overlay.use-in-ai-dialog.description: MCP 'Use in your AI' connect dialog: rail of 11 AI clients, per-client mode switch (One click / Config file / Ask the agent), code and prompt cards with copy buttons; bottom sheet below 768px.
overlay.use-in-ai-dialog.scope: Opened from the homepage hero button and from the MCP index's client cards.

nav.breadcrumb.description: Small trail of parent links above a detail page's hero.
nav.breadcrumb.scope: Piece detail, MCP detail, piece pair, blog article and resource detail templates.
nav.breadcrumb.implementedBy: catalog/parts.jsx > Breadcrumb; content/parts.jsx (article and resource breadcrumbs)

nav.category-pills.description: Horizontal row of blog category pills ('All' plus each category) with the active one filled.
nav.category-pills.scope: Blog index and blog category templates.

nav.pagination.description: Numbered page links with a windowed range and prev/next arrows for blog listings.
nav.pagination.scope: Blog index, blog category and blog author templates.

nav.toc.description: Sticky 'On this page' rail with scroll-spy over the body's h2s; on articles it shows only at >=1280px and only when the article has a rail on the live site (hasToc or not in the 63-slug NO_TOC list).
nav.toc.scope: Blog article and resource detail templates.

hero.home.description: Homepage hero: sky background with two layered plates fading in, non-animated H1, staggered subhead and CTAs including the 'Use in your AI' button with its logo fan and sheen.

hero.template.description: Left-aligned product/solution hero: H1, lede, dark 'Start building' + secondary CTA, then a 32px-radius stage with a background image holding a demo (flow, agent, tables or chat) or a static solution mock. Entrance .tpl-line (.64s, i x 70ms).
hero.template.implementedBy: templates/TemplateHero.jsx (+ templates/TablesDemo.jsx, templates/ChatDemo.jsx, FeatureFlowDemo.jsx, FeatureAgentsDemo.jsx, templates/solutionHeroMocks.jsx)

hero.embed.description: Embed product hero: same markup family as hero.template but a separate component, with the homepage flow-canvas demo in the stage and three highlight columns below.

hero.security.description: Dark security hero with the animated ASCII cipher-wall canvas and rotating 3D lock, plus a four-fact row.

hero.governance.description: Image-card hero with a 1280x720 admin-screen mock scaled into place and a customer-logo bar pinned to the viewport bottom.

hero.catalog.description: Catalog hero in three variants: /pieces 3D logo scatter (>=1152px) or logo cluster, /mcp scatter plus five client cards that open the connect dialog, and a plain left-aligned hero for category pages.
hero.catalog.scope: Pieces index, MCP index and catalog category templates.

hero.resources.description: Soft-gradient resources hero with staggered blur-in lines (.res-hero-line): optional breadcrumb, H1, subtitle, buttons.
hero.resources.scope: Resources hub and resource category templates.

hero.listing.description: Plain listing header: H1 with the blog title, category name or author name (author variant adds avatar and bio line); the index variant adds the search field.
hero.listing.scope: Blog index, blog category and blog author templates.

proof.customer-marquee.description: Infinite right-to-left marquee of 24 customer logos with faded edges (82.8s loop >=768px, 72s below).

proof.logo-rotator.description: Grid of six customer logos that swaps to the next set every 3.5s with a 40ms per-cell stagger.
proof.logo-rotator.implementedBy: templates/LogoRotator.jsx (solutions, ai-governance); pricing/RotatingLogos.jsx (pricing) - two implementations of one section

proof.case-study.description: Customer case study: logo, large Sentient quote with attribution, three-stat row (v4 divide semantics).

proof.testimonials.description: Nine review cards in up to three columns with a bottom fade, review-source logos and a two-stat block; heading set per page.

product.app-mockup.description: Large app-window mockup card that overlaps the hero by -308px (2/1 desktop, 4/3 at >=640, 2/3 below).

product.dream-story.description: Sticky 420svh scroll story: three text beats, seven app windows flying in and collapsing, and a 9-card wire diagram drawing itself; a one-shot 2.4s animation at <=1023px.

product.feature-agents.description: 'Agents that get the job done' feature block with the scripted agent-thread demo (fake cursor, tool calls, approve).
product.feature-agents.scope: Homepage only (the demo itself is reused inside hero.template).

product.feature-flow.description: 'Simple by default. Deep on demand.' feature block with the scripted flow-canvas demo.
product.feature-flow.scope: Homepage only (the demo itself is reused inside hero.template and hero.embed).

product.hero-columns.description: Three text columns under a product hero's stage describing the product's pillars.

product.bento-grid.description: Heading plus a 24-column bento grid of cards, each with a title, description and a mock UI sheet over an art background.
product.bento-grid.scope: Homepage (twice), product, solution and embed templates.
product.bento-grid.implementedBy: BentoPlatformCard.jsx (shared card) via BentoPlatform.jsx, BentoSecond.jsx, templates/TemplateBento.jsx, embed/EmbedBento.jsx

product.pieces-mosaic.description: '760+ open-source pieces' logo mosaic spelling 760+, popping in on mount and swapping one logo every 820ms.

product.feature-rows.description: Scroll section whose right-hand stage stays pinned and swaps between three mock visuals as each text row reaches mid-viewport.

product.icon-band.description: Heading plus a band of icon cards (six on security, nine on ai-governance) with solid or gradient background.

product.models-grid.description: Scroll-scrubbed grid of five cards and eight AI-model tiles flying into place; pins only at >=1280x768.

product.rollout-deck.description: Pinned four-panel deck that opens one panel at a time as the user scrolls.

cta.band.description: Full-width rounded CTA card with a 28px heading, one line of copy and brand + secondary buttons.

cta.inline.description: Compact mid-page CTA (title, body, Start building) inside catalog detail pages, shown only when the piece has capability sections.
cta.inline.scope: Piece detail and MCP detail templates.

pricing.plans.description: Plans header with the Monthly/Annual clip-path toggle and four plan cards with count-up prices and hover tooltips.

pricing.split-rows.description: Embed and Enterprise rows sharing one background image.

pricing.compare-table.description: Feature comparison table with a sticky header on desktop that becomes plan tabs below 1024px (Plus selected).

form.sales-form.description: Talk-to-sales form card: work-email validation with error text, conditional 'Other' input and a 'Thanks, {name}' end state; never submits over the network.

proof.sales-pitch.description: Sticky pitch card beside the sales form: quote plus a logo grid swapping one random logo every 1.4s, joined to the form by a white 'bridge' notch.

content.oss-friends-grid.description: Heading, link cards for open-source friend projects (local logos with first-letter fallback) and a credits block.

catalog.browser.description: Searchable catalog grid: 120ms debounced search, multi-select category filter, sort (Popular / A-Z / Most actions|tools), 24 per page with Show more, URL sync, empty state.
catalog.browser.scope: Pieces index, MCP index and catalog category templates.

catalog.category-grid.description: Grid of category cards linking to each category page.
catalog.category-grid.scope: Pieces index and MCP index only (rendered only when there are category cards).

catalog.az-index.description: Collapsible A-Z list of every piece link.
catalog.az-index.scope: Pieces index, MCP index and catalog category templates.

catalog.detail-hero.description: Piece/MCP detail hero: logo, name, description, CTAs and a facts row (auth, version, updated, counts).
catalog.detail-hero.scope: Piece detail and MCP detail templates.

catalog.about.scope: Piece detail and MCP detail templates.

catalog.capabilities.description: Lists of the piece's triggers and actions (or tools and triggers for MCP), one section per non-empty kind.
catalog.capabilities.scope: Piece detail and MCP detail templates.

catalog.guides.description: 'Guides using {piece}' links into the blog, when the piece has any.
catalog.guides.scope: Piece detail and MCP detail templates.

catalog.pairings.description: 'Popular {piece} pairings' grid linking to pair pages.
catalog.pairings.scope: Piece detail only (MCP detail has no pairings).

catalog.related.description: Grid of related pieces with a 'browse all' link.
catalog.related.scope: Piece detail, MCP detail and piece pair templates (twice on pair pages: one per piece).

catalog.pair-hero.description: Pair hero with both piece logos, the integration headline and four facts.

catalog.automation-ideas.description: Generated automation ideas combining A's triggers with B's actions and vice versa (algorithm in catalog/lib.js).

content.featured-post.description: Latest post featured large (two columns at >=1024px) with its generated cover.

content.post-grid.description: 12-card post grid (3/2/1 columns) with covers, titles, excerpts and meta.
content.post-grid.scope: Blog index, blog category and blog author templates.

content.progress-bar.description: 2px reading-progress bar fixed at the top of the viewport.

content.article-header.description: 3:1 cover banner with live title text, excerpt, author chip with hover popover, and share buttons.

content.article-body.description: Prose column rendering the placeholder body (all prose styles) plus the 'Read the full article on activepieces.com' link; real bodies are intentionally not stored.

content.signup-card.description: Sticky sign-up card in the right rail with five peeking bot avatars (5s peek loop, hover pose), at >=1024px.

content.keep-reading.description: Closing CTA card (four copy variants chosen by slug) and three same-category 'Keep reading' cards.

content.resource-type-grid.description: Tiles linking to the four resource types (glossary, automation guides, automation use cases, integration use cases).

content.resource-listing.description: Resource listing: glossary letter jump-nav with per-letter sections, or 24 cards with Show more for the other types; search with empty state.

content.keep-exploring.description: 'Keep exploring.' cross-links to the other resource types.

content.resource-body.description: 704px resource article with placeholder body, 'Build this in Activepieces' box, 'Apps in this guide' and the read-full link.

faq.accordion.description: Single-open FAQ accordion (first item open, 200ms height/opacity, plus icon rotates 45 degrees); heading and items passed per page.
faq.accordion.scope: Homepage, product, solution, pricing, security, ai-governance, embed, pieces/MCP index, catalog category, piece/MCP detail and piece pair templates.

faq.resource-faq.description: Multi-open FAQ with instant toggles (first item open); a different behaviour from faq.accordion, hence a separate component.
faq.resource-faq.scope: Resource category and resource detail templates.

legal.nav.description: Sticky 'Legal' side nav (272px column, collapsible on mobile) listing the document's sections.

legal.document.description: 848px legal column with numbered all-caps headings hanging in the gutter at >=1024px, placeholder text and a link to the full document on activepieces.com.

templates.name: Piece integration pair
templates.routePattern: /pieces/{a}/{b} (3,000 listed in the sitemap: 250 sources x 12 targets; the clone accepts any two distinct valid slugs)

templates.name: Blog author
templates.routePattern: /blog/author/{slug} (56 in the sitemap; 95 authors in src/data/blog.json)
